t_raise: One question, everybody answers, keep it short: {topic}
No niin, a question for the fire, and no long answers: {topic}
eino_barbarian.t_react_warm: Joo, {name}, good answer. I liked that one.
eino_barbarian.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, that's funny, and I don't laugh much.
eino_barbarian.t_react_tease: Too short even for me, {name}, and I'm the short one.
eino_barbarian.t_react_same: Same for me, {name}. Strange, but true.
eino_barbarian.t_ask_player: Your turn, {player}, answer. Short is fine.
eino_barbarian.t_guess_player: {player} says nothing, like a Finn. I approve of that.
eino_barbarian.topic_miss_most: Snow, all of you, deep snow, and dark at two in the afternoon. And a sauna, and a lake with a hole cut in the ice.
eino_barbarian.topic_first_night: Under a tree, sweating, in a jungle. I thought it was hell, and I'm still not sure it isn't.
eino_barbarian.topic_worst_shift: The harvester broke at minus forty, far out, no signal. I fixed it with wire and swearing, and it took nine hours.
eino_barbarian.topic_last_meal: Salmon soup, the creamy kind, with rye bread, and coffee after, very strong, and then more coffee.
eino_barbarian.topic_useless_skill: I can drop a tree exactly where I want it, to the centimetre. Here the goblins just knock everything over.
eino_barbarian.topic_here_better: The trees here are enormous, all of you. Nobody planted them, and I'd like to keep it that way.
eino_barbarian.topic_kid_trouble: At ten I built a sauna in the woods from scrap, and it caught fire. My grandfather said it was the best sauna in the village, while it lasted.
eino_barbarian.topic_settle_down: Somewhere cold, with snow and a lake. A hut, a sauna, a forest left standing, and quiet.

t_raise: A question for the evening, everyone, and precise answers, please: {topic}
Colleagues, a small survey, purely for my records: {topic}
henrik_mage.t_react_warm: That's a well constructed answer, {name}, and rather moving, which I didn't expect.
henrik_mage.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, that's genuinely funny, outside my expected tolerance for funny.
henrik_mage.t_react_tease: That answer has no load bearing content at all, {name}. Try again with data.
henrik_mage.t_react_same: {name}, that's my answer as well, to the decimal. A curious result.
henrik_mage.t_ask_player: And yours, {player}? Please be specific, I'll be taking notes.
henrik_mage.t_guess_player: {player} is withholding the data, I see. Wise, perhaps, given this audience.
henrik_mage.topic_miss_most: Cycling to work along the harbour in Copenhagen, everyone, in the rain, with fifty thousand other people doing exactly the same thing in an orderly line.
henrik_mage.topic_first_night: On a stone bridge, measuring it, because it was the only thing I could think to do. It was well built, and that calmed me down.
henrik_mage.topic_worst_shift: An architect who wanted a glass floor over a forty metre drop, cantilevered, for a restaurant. I said no eleven times in one meeting.
henrik_mage.topic_last_meal: Smorrebrod, on dark rye, herring and egg and dill, with a cold beer, at a table by the canal.
henrik_mage.topic_useless_skill: I can estimate the load on any beam by looking at it, within five percent. Here most beams are tree trunks, and they don't care.
henrik_mage.topic_here_better: The ice in the Frostward Descent behaves like steel, colleagues. Nobody on Earth has ever had a material like it to work with.
henrik_mage.topic_kid_trouble: At twelve I built a bridge across the stream behind our house from my father's fence. It held, and he never forgave me for the fence.
henrik_mage.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with good bridges and bad weather. A flat with tall windows and a bicycle.

t_raise: Hey, hey, gente, a question for all of us, uai: {topic}
Gente, sit, sit, here's one for the fire: {topic}
thiago_paladin.t_react_warm: Nossa, {name}, that's beautiful, come here, let me hug you.
thiago_paladin.t_react_laugh: Uai, {name}, I'm crying laughing, you're too much!
thiago_paladin.t_react_tease: That's all, {name}? My patients said more than that with their jaw wired shut.
thiago_paladin.t_react_same: {name}, meu irmao, that's mine too! We should be brothers now.
thiago_paladin.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Go on, meu irmao, no wrong answers at my fire.
thiago_paladin.t_guess_player: {player}'s smiling and saying nothing, gente. That's a good sign, I promise.
thiago_paladin.topic_miss_most: A boteco in Belo Horizonte on a Friday, gente, cold beer, pao de queijo, and the whole street arguing about Atletico.
thiago_paladin.topic_first_night: Sitting up with a stranger who couldn't stop shaking, under a tree. I didn't know her name until morning, and she's still a friend.
thiago_paladin.topic_worst_shift: A patient who'd been told he'd never walk, and he believed it, for six months. The day he finally stood up, I had to go and cry in the cupboard.
thiago_paladin.topic_last_meal: Feijao tropeiro, a big plate of it, with sausage and greens and an egg on top, and a guarana, cold.
thiago_paladin.topic_useless_skill: I can tell which knee you hurt as a kid by how you walk. Here everybody's knees are terrible, so it's not much of a trick.
thiago_paladin.topic_here_better: Healing works, gente, it just works. Ten years I wished I could put my hand on a bad knee and fix it.
thiago_paladin.topic_kid_trouble: I set a friend's dislocated finger at nine, after watching a doctor on television. It worked, and I got grounded anyway.
thiago_paladin.topic_settle_down: Somewhere warm with a big kitchen, uai, a table for twenty, and a little clinic next door.

t_raise: Ragazzi, quick question, like a fast attack, everyone answers: {topic}
Jamme, a question for the fire, and no feints: {topic}
enzo_cultist.t_react_warm: Bello, {name}, a clean touch, that answer, really lovely.
enzo_cultist.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, mannaggia, you got me, I nearly dropped my glass.
enzo_cultist.t_react_tease: That's your attack, {name}? No point awarded, try again with your feet.
enzo_cultist.t_react_same: Ha, {name}, the same touch I'd have made. We should fence a pair.
enzo_cultist.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? En garde, your turn, and no hiding behind the parry.
enzo_cultist.t_guess_player: {player}'s holding their guard, ragazzi, waiting for the opening, very tactical.
enzo_cultist.topic_miss_most: Riding my scooter through the Spanish Quarter at night, ragazzi, washing lines overhead, everybody shouting from the balconies.
enzo_cultist.topic_first_night: On the grass outside a monastery, holding my glove, listening to monks shouting drill orders. I didn't sleep at all.
enzo_cultist.topic_worst_shift: The Olympic trials, the second time, last touch, fourteen all, and I hesitated. Half a second. That's the worst day I ever had at work.
enzo_cultist.topic_last_meal: My mother's ragu, cooked all Sunday morning, on ziti, and then a baba al rum, and an espresso standing at the bar.
enzo_cultist.topic_useless_skill: I can hit a coin on the floor with the tip of a sabre from two metres. Here nobody uses coins that small.
enzo_cultist.topic_here_better: The fights are real, ragazzi, no buttons on the tips, no referee. Every touch matters, and I've never fenced better.
enzo_cultist.topic_kid_trouble: At nine I fenced the priest's nephew with two umbrellas in the church square. I won, and we both got a slap.
enzo_cultist.topic_settle_down: Somewhere by the sea, with a little salle, and children on Saturday mornings learning footwork.

t_raise: A question, everyone, no rush, one at a time: {topic}
Okay, slowly, everybody answers this one: {topic}
junseo_reaper.t_react_warm: That's good, {name}, really good, I like it.
junseo_reaper.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, okay, you made me smile, the lines are working.
junseo_reaper.t_react_tease: Aigo, {name}, that's a very small answer. Even I said more.
junseo_reaper.t_react_same: Jinjja, {name}, mine is the same exactly, which is strange.
junseo_reaper.t_ask_player: Your turn, {player}, if that's okay. No hurry at all.
junseo_reaper.t_guess_player: {player} is thinking very carefully, everyone. Like carving, slow is good.
junseo_reaper.topic_miss_most: Instant noodles at four in the morning in the break room, everyone, after the shift, with the baseball replay on the little television.
junseo_reaper.topic_first_night: I worked, actually, the first night. Carried things for a goblin camp until morning, because I didn't know what else to do.
junseo_reaper.topic_worst_shift: A double shift in August, the air conditioning broken, and a quota they doubled at noon. Three men fainted, and they didn't stop the line.
junseo_reaper.topic_last_meal: Dwaeji gukbap, the pork soup from Busan, with rice and kimchi on the side, at a little place by the harbour.
junseo_reaper.topic_useless_skill: I can weld a straight seam with my eyes closed. Here there's nothing to weld, so I carve, very badly.
junseo_reaper.topic_here_better: Nobody here shouts the quota, everyone. I can stop when I'm tired, and nobody docks my pay.
junseo_reaper.topic_kid_trouble: At ten I took apart a neighbour's bicycle to see how it worked, and put it back with three parts left over. It still worked, mostly.
junseo_reaper.topic_settle_down: Somewhere quiet by the sea, with a bench, and a piece of wood, and nowhere I need to be.
